name: Iliotibial Band Syndrome
definition: Overuse-related lateral knee pain associated with compression and irritation of tissues beneath the iliotibial band near the lateral femoral epicondyle.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical; imaging is used only when alternative pathology is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent symptoms require reassessment for alternative lateral-knee diagnoses.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu/Jangha Snayu overuse phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Overuse-related lateral knee pain associated with compression and irritation of tissues beneath the iliotibial band near the lateral femoral epicondyle.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
